paper_verdict.estimator_family: AMG (augmented mean group) / heterogeneous-panel with common factors; MG baseline; pooled first-difference OLS with year dummies for Table 2
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is the authors' own estimated ln TFP (sector-level, AMG-derived), not labour productivity; ICT exposure is log ICT investment, coefficients are small elasticities. Table 2 estimates are first-differences (short run), not comparable with the level estimates in Table 1; MG/MG robust/AMG robust rows share the same data and are not independent. Endogeneity handled only via common-factor augmentation, no explicit reverse-causality test.

estimates.note: Column order MG, MG Robust, AMG Robust checked. Table 2 note says robust standard errors. ITC is ICT investment (log). Outcome is estimated TFP level, sector-by-country panel (17 countries, 13 sectors); income group not stated (EU).

paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is labour productivity per hour (2012 US$, 2005 EKS PPP); table does not print the dependent variable and it is unclear whether it is logged, so log(ICTS) coefficients may or may not be elasticities. ICT exposure is ICT spending as % of GDP (logged); Internet users per 100 people is a level semi-elasticity. Full sample, CEE/WE subsamples and sub-period estimates overlap in data (not independent). Very small samples in sub-period regressions (N 28-112) with many regressors; no endogeneity treatment.
